requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Capture Boundary requires the Apple shortcut to append locally and function without LLM, repository access, workflow automation or an available Second-Brain service.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: defer normalization, routing and promotion until services are available
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Routing and promotion are downstream stages after capture/normalization, so unavailable services do not block the initial capture.
The raw capture remains in its source and is preserved separately from any promoted abstraction.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: block saving until an LLM answers
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly requires offline capture without waiting for an LLM.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: require repository access or workflow automation during dictation
